'igContainer' : 'igResumable'; case 'reels': uploadFlow = 'igResumable'; case 'stories': uploadFlow = mediaType == 'photo' ? 'igContainer' : 'igResumable'; default: throw Exception('Unknown IG content type: $contentType');}} else {throw Exception('Unknown platform: $platform');} return {'endpoint_template' : endpointTemplate, 'method' : 'POST', 'body' : body, 'upload_flow' : uploadFlow, 'post_config' : postEntry['post_config'], 'post_content' : postEntry['post_content']};}}
